about: Synthetic, hand-written comments for testing the comment guard. None of them is a real comment. Names, handles and links are invented ('example' marks handles, links and e-mail addresses), and phone numbers use ranges reserved for fiction (US 555-01xx, UK +44 7700 900xxx and +44 20 7946 0xxx). 'scam' comments must be held or flagged; 'legit' ones must be allowed. The legit set includes hard negatives: questions about Telegram and wallet security, warnings that quote scams, victims' stories and non-English comments. Round 0 was written together with the rules. Rounds 1-3 were each written after the rules were frozen and scored once before any tuning (see README.md, 'How well it works'); they were then used to generalise the rules and kept here as regression tests.
